name: blacklist
description: The ENCODE blacklist (version 2, Boyle lab) for this genome's build, stored exactly as published, with a record of the fetch. Registered only after every interval was found to lie on a sequence this genome has and within its length (bin/prepare_resource.py); the result of that check is in the asset's provenance file. This replaces refgenie's stock `blacklist` recipe, which copies whatever file it is handed and checks nothing.

required_files.description: the gzipped BED file as published
the fetch record and compatibility summary

required_assets.description: the genome whose coordinates the intervals are in
